title: nephrodium scabrum
intro: Nephrodium scabrum, commonly known as the Rough Horsetail or Rough Lycopodium, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family, a group of ancient and primitive vascular plants. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in promoting digestive health and reducing inflammation, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium scabrum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Traditionally, the plant has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and skin conditions.
